description:
Get a company's shares outstanding over time, as stated on the cover page of
each 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F and 40-F (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding).

One row per share class and as-of date, oldest first, each with the filing it
comes from (source). Counts are as filed and never split-adjusted, so a stock
split appears as a jump in ratio_to_previous (the count divided by the same
class's previous count; Apple 2020: 3.98 for its 4-for-1, the gap being
buybacks).

splits lists every stock split and reverse split found, each with its ratio
("4-for-1", "3-for-2", "1-for-10"), the dates it falls between (happened_after,
by) and the 10-K/10-Q that first restated the company's earlier share counts
by that ratio, which accounting rules require for every split (source: cite
it). restated_figures is how many share counts were restated: 1-2 is thin
evidence. Two splits between the same two filings show as one with the
combined ratio. share_count_tagging_corrections are jumps of 1000x or
1,000,000x in the reported data that were the company fixing the scale of its
XBRL share-count tag, not splits. Covers 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F and 40-F filers
(a 20-F/40-F filer reports once a year, so its window is about a year wide).
A split is listed once a filing has restated the share counts, so a
ratio_to_previous far from 1 with no split listed is worth checking in the
filing. Use this for share-count history, dilution, buybacks and splits
instead of reading filings one by one.

Multi-class companies (Alphabet, Meta) have one series per class, named by the
XBRL member (CommonClassAMember, CapitalClassCMember); "listed" maps classes to
tickers from the newest filing. Covers filings from coverage_from (2009) on,
for companies that tagged the count in XBRL. Filer errors (a zero, a mistyped
date) are returned as filed.

Args:
    cik: Company CIK (e.g. "320193" for Apple)
    share_class: Only this class, as returned in share_class (optional)
    from_date: Earliest as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD)
    to_date: Latest as-of date (YYYY-MM-DD)
name: get_shares_outstanding
title: Get Shares Outstanding
